summary: Accepted after independent Chinese-source and exact sealed-replay review. The proposal changes exactly three unsupported personal chronology claims and their three paired hints. s0001 dates a Zhangzong-era edict that changes Wei Shaowang's taboo name because of Xianzong; it is not an activity date for Xianzong. s0193 lists Yang Yunyi's and Old Chen's daily records among materials held in the History Office; it supplies no Daan or Chongqing personal date for either author. All named source evidence remains intact and is retained as explicit research-held context. This receipt does not mutate or approve the canonical extraction.
